newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market steady at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market steady at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry and demand fair. Feedlots very current.

Sales confirmed on 1,100 slaughter steers and 500 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 103,100 head confirmed including 16,800 head or about 16 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1275 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1125 lbs 66.00.
Confirmed - 1,600 last week - 12,400 last year - none
Wk to date - 103,100 last week - 102,600 last year - 65,100
